archive: SUBLEVEL B2-114 PHYSICAL REALIA, MINUTIAE & FAN THEORIES MANIFEST

physical_exhibits.title: Canter's Deli 03:14 AM Delivery Receipt #08419 & Rejected Petty Cash Form OR-409-B
physical_exhibits.summary: Marcus Hale ordered 1x Hot Pastrami on Rye and 7x Black Coffees at 03:14 AM. Orion Accounting disallowed $12.40 because badge logs showed only 1 human in Sublevel B2; 6 coffees were placed around the empty Neumann U87 stand for wiped Units 01-06.

physical_exhibits.title: Pacific Magnetics Corp. Work Order #PM-88-1104 (Studer A800 S/N 3109)
physical_exhibits.summary: Field technician Gary Kowalski documents unauthorized 14.2001 Hz quartz oscillator soldered across the Studer A800 Channel 2 bias trap and 14 cases of cheap consumer Maxell UR-90 Type-I ferric cassettes behind the patchbay.

physical_exhibits.title: Bavaria Filmstudios Munich Casting & Wardrobe Voucher #CP-81.SC.01
physical_exhibits.summary: DM 14,800 invoice for four hired fashion models and unplugged Roland Jupiter-8 / Linn LM-1 stage props to fabricate the 1981 Europop band 'Crystal Promise — Shining City' as a synthetic memory seed for Units 01-07.

physical_exhibits.title: Underground Tape-Trader Xeroxed J-Card Inserts (#B-09, #B-14, #B-22)
physical_exhibits.summary: Hand-annotated cassette J-cards documenting Nakamichi Dragon optical auto-reverse triggers at 03:14, Coyoacán swap-meet dubs, and the 'S.V. // 04-14' yellow grease-pencil mark on every Mylar leader.

physical_exhibits.title: Sunset Gower Freight Elevator #4 Night Watchman Clipboard Log (R. Delgado)
physical_exhibits.summary: Documents Freight Elevator #4 rising empty (000 lbs) at 01:40 AM with a Walkman coupled to the dock payphone, and Nova Hart asking over talkback at 02:15 AM if the jacaranda trees on Sunset Blvd were blooming.

physical_exhibits.title: 1986 Hollerith 80-Column Punch Card Bookmark & Whited-Out Reel SD-0037
physical_exhibits.summary: IBM 5081 punch card bookmark ('I HEARD YOU BREATHE BETWEEN THE BARS') and Inventory Form OR-712's whited-out 37th entry: 'SD-0037 // Room Tone (Iso Booth B Unoccupied)'.

fan_theories_and_red_herrings.name: The Ilse Von Berg / Kidnapped East Berlin Soprano Red Herring
fan_theories_and_red_herrings.explanation: 1991 alt.fan.nova-hart theory claiming a 3,412 Hz spike on 'Shining City' was an East German vowel formant. Debunked when Ilse Von Berg was found teaching school in Augsburg and comp.dsp proved the spike was a 12-bit M68000 quantization overflow.

fan_theories_and_red_herrings.name: The 1992 Barstow Desert Dig & 42.6 RPM Backmasking Fiasco
fan_theories_and_red_herrings.explanation: Seven tape traders dug under an abandoned AT&T Long Lines microwave horn near Barstow, CA after hearing 'backward coordinates' on Gasoline Heart—only to discover their unshielded tape head was picking up KWKW 1300 AM heterodyning with the 14.2 Hz bias tone.

fan_theories_and_red_herrings.name: The 'S.V. // 04-14' Mylar Leader Mystery
fan_theories_and_red_herrings.explanation: Debated as (A) vanished receptionist Sabine Vance, (B) Sub-Vocal Bus // April 14 [1983], (C) ASCII 0x5356 ^ 0x3A5F = 0x6909 (Sept 9 raid date), or (D) Sunnyvale Video liquidation bin #04-14.

fan_theories_and_red_herrings.name: Luna Gray's 1991 MTV Europe Eyelid Morse Code vs. 3:2 Pulldown Judder
fan_theories_and_red_herrings.explanation: London VHS frame-steppers decoded 'STILL IN B2' from Luna Gray's blinks; broadcast engineers blamed 24fps->NTSC->PAL DEFT field interpolation, until VBI Line 21 showed the 3:2 pulldown resets were phase-locked to 14.2001 Hz.

fan_theories_and_red_herrings.name: Reel SD-0037 ('Room Tone in an Empty Booth', 46:14)
fan_theories_and_red_herrings.explanation: At 31:14.2001 of an empty, locked vocal booth recording (+48 dB gain), a metal chair creaks, pages turn, and an unaccompanied voice hums D4-E4-F4-A4 before whispering 'Marcus, you left the red light on.'
